== Dated PC image versions ==
The exact Holotable sources for this family date to 2018-07-08, 2022-12-23. These images retain the same game text while their published orientation, frame or artwork changes. Original bytes and documented unscaled crops accompany each article. Historical pages do not invent playable IDs. The HiRez image correctly belongs to the printed Decipher article: its words match the Decipher archive face. These PC images have their own later words.
